title: Anaphylaxis first move
caption:
Anaphylaxis in an adult: IM adrenaline 0.5 mg (0.5 mL of 1 mg/mL) into the anterolateral thigh. Antihistamines are not the first move.

Save this for your EMREE week.

fact.claim: Adult anaphylaxis first-line: IM adrenaline 0.5 mg (1 mg/mL), anterolateral thigh; antihistamines are not first-line
